dataset_recommendation.recommendation: Use GTEx for healthy human bulk RNA-seq validation across the target tissues; preserve TCGA for disease analysis and ARCHS4 for cross-pipeline robustness.

role_rationale: GTEx covers all five target organs with explicit donor IDs and a single harmonized consortium pipeline. It can test donor-level external domain shift but cannot by itself establish multisource cross-study generalization.

release.release_note: V11 updates V10 to GENCODE 47 and contains no new samples or donors compared with V10.

expression_object_catalog_binding.description: Gene Expression Read Counts from RNASeQCv2.4.3 with LCM samples excluded.
expression_object_catalog_binding.why_counts_not_portal_tpm: The frozen model contract creates TPM from counts using the exact canonical gene universe and frozen exon-length table, then applies log1p once in the scorer. Portal TPM would use a different denominator and length contract.

explicit_anatomy_exclusions.Brain - Spinal cord (cervical c-1): adjacent nervous-system tissue, not UBERON brain
explicit_anatomy_exclusions.all BMS-prefixed rows: LCM pilot identifiers absent from the selected main bulk object

sample_selection_contract.matrix_membership_rule: At the later freeze gate, intersect this metadata cohort with the exact sample-ID header of the pinned LCM-excluded counts object. Any mismatch is a technical hold and cannot be resolved using observed model effects.

historical_overlap_contract.exclusion_policy: Exclude each overlapping donor globally from every target organ, even when the historical aliquot came from only one organ.

steps: average the three frozen training-seed losses within each sample
average all retained tissue sites or biological samples within donor and organ
give equal donor mass within organ
give equal mass to all five organs
aggregation_contract.tissue_site_diagnostics: report site-specific effects without using them to select or rescue the primary result
aggregation_contract.rationale: GTEx has repeated organs and tissue sites per donor; sample-level weighting would overrepresent donors with more collected sites.

health_interpretation.allowed_description: adult human postmortem or organ-donor tissue from GTEx non-diseased tissue sites
health_interpretation.postmortem_policy: included prospectively as part of the GTEx secondary domain-shift estimand
health_interpretation.incidental_pathology_policy: retain the public pathology notes and use the official GTEx bulk matrix/QC inclusion prospectively; do not select samples based on model effects
health_interpretation.claim_limit: GTEx tests nominally non-diseased tissue under a harmonized consortium pipeline and postmortem collection regime.

expression_contract_status.proposed_input: pinned V11 RNASeQC gene read-count GCT with LCM samples excluded
expression_contract_status.frozen_model_space: 15,448 ordered canonical genes; TPM created once with the frozen GENCODE v49 exon-length table; log1p applied once by the scorer
expression_contract_status.required_gene_mapping_audit: strip Ensembl version suffixes, bind GENCODE v47 identifiers/symbols, aggregate repeated canonical symbols before TPM, and freeze missing/duplicate-gene handling
expression_contract_status.pipeline_shift: GTEx STAR/RNASeQC versus ARCHS4 Kallisto is an intended robustness dimension, not a preprocessing equivalence claim

remaining_gates: implement and test the GTEx count-to-canonical-TPM extractor without external expression
freeze exact matrix-header membership and the inclusion/exclusion ledger
complete the full ARCHS4-pretraining donor/near-duplicate overlap audit
freeze the donor-clustered evaluator and secondary decision interpretation
pass synthetic and historical-data smoke tests
only then authorize one-time expression download and scoring
